biological_replicate: HeLa cells were transfected with constructs encoding FLAG-BirA-RNF8 and AP-HA-Ub
experimental_design: Identification of RNF8 substrates via BirA-proximity labeling and mapping of NONO ubiquitination sites

To identify potential substrates of RNF8, cells were transfected with FLAG-BirA-RNF8 and AP-HA-Ub... we mapped ubiquitination sites on NONO by mass spectrometry following overexpression of FLAG-NONO and HA-RNF8
factor_value: cells were transfected with FLAG-BirA-RNF8 and AP-HA-Ub... overexpression of FLAG-NONO and HA-RNF8
